system.description: Starting at 18th level you have learned to utilize your Genjutsu to break your foes mind and shatter their will to survive. Creatures who are Mentally Compromised can no longer spend their Actions to attempt to end hostile effects on them such as spending an Action to end the Burned, Corroded or Bruised conditions. Additionally, by spending 1 Actualization Die a creature you touch gains the Mentally Compromised status.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
